description: Override for quotingAI__createAmendmentQuote. Resolves Asset origin chain, creates Opportunity, calls initiateAmendment with pre-resolved OpportunityId and ContractId, then populates Fortra-specific fields including Quote_Type__c=Amendment and default Amendment_Reason__c=Upsell.

formulas.expression:
IF(
    ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_Original_Quote.Deal_Type__c})),
    "",
    IF(
        TEXT({!Get_Original_Quote.Deal_Type__c}) = "Fortra Originated",
        "Fortra Originated",
        "Channel Originated"
    )
)
formulas.name: formula_TransformedDealType

label: Fortra | Create Amendment Quote
